cases.title: Initiate drag event on product item
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true' and data-testid='product-item-1') successfully initiates a drag event.

cases.title: Capture product title during drag
cases.description: Verify that the drag event captures the product's title identified by the data-testid attribute (e.g., 'product-title-1') for transfer.

cases.title: Capture product price during drag
cases.description: Verify that the drag event captures the product's price identified by the data-testid attribute (e.g., 'product-price-1') for transfer.

cases.title: Drag and drop product items into the designated drop area
cases.description: Verify that users can drag and drop product items (data-testid='product-item-1', data-testid='product-item-2', etc.) into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') to add them to the cart.

cases.title: Automatically update cart display properties upon dropping
cases.description: Verify that upon dropping a product, the cart display automatically updates such that the product title appears in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1.

cases.title: Support adding both different and repeated products
cases.description: Verify that the system supports adding both different products and repeated products into the cart.

cases.title: Calculate and Display Total Price with Two Decimal Places and Currency Symbol
cases.description: Verify that the system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays it in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases adequately cover the requirements without any confirmed blockers. All scenarios map cleanly to the stated functional requirements.
All test cases map correctly to the given requirements, and there are no blockers or redundant test cases.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1 describes multiple distinct behaviors: initiating a drag event on 'li' elements with 'draggable=true', capturing the product's title via data-testid, and capturing the product's price via data-testid. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3 describes multiple distinct behaviors: allowing drag and drop of product items into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'), automatically updating the cart display with product title in .box2, unit price in .box3, and quantity in .box1, and supporting the addition of both different and repeated products. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5 describes multiple distinct behaviors: summing the prices of all products in the cart for the total price, formatting the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displaying this total in the <div id='allMoney'> element.
